result.description:
Our company, Vee H Aviation, trading as Corporate Air and Link Airways are an aviation service company that provides regional airline and charter services to customers in eastern and southern Australia.

We are currently seeking a suitably experienced Aircraft Maintenance Engineer to join our AMO line at Brisbane Airport. (ANZSCO 323111)

Salary per annum: $90,000-$95,000

About you:
- Identify and implement systems and processes to and ensure company and regulatory compliance including the effective running of WinAir.
- Communicate effectively with staff at all levels, internal / external customers, suppliers / vendors on AMO matters as required by the Company.
- Ability to commit to and deliver quality outcomes IAW negotiated deadlines,
- Ability to navigate and comprehend company and aircraft manufacturer manuals.
- Ability to navigate and comprehend CASA regulations,
- Ability to effectively use WinAir software, and
- Hold or qualify to hold an ASIC card

Who are we looking for?
- To be successful in this role you will require:
- Must have a sound knowledge of aircraft maintenance skills: - This maybe be proven through evidence of a Certificate 4 in Aero Skills or equivalent.
- Must have previously demonstrated skills in aircraft maintenance: - Current experience as shown by reference to time served with company or statement from previous employer. 
- Must have a minimum of 3 Years aircraft maintenance experience, which may include an apprenticeship: - This maybe be proven through evidence of a certificate 4 in aero skills or equivalent.
- Display attention to detail and high degree of accuracy;
- To demonstrate ability to use your initiative to problem solve.
- The ability to work a shift rotating through our seven day a week operation, on a rotating roster and some (paid) overtime requirements are expected.
- To pass a pre-employment Drug and Alcohol pathology screening.

The position is full-time and will require a dedicated individual who is looking for a career in a long-established and leading aviation Company.

For more information about the Company www.linkairways.com and www.corporate-air.com.au

Whilst we thank all applicants for their interest in this role, only short-listed candidates will be contacted.
